observations: Photo 0 shows a used gearbox or transmission with the bell housing removed, exposing a large circular clutch or torque converter assembly; a second similar circular plate is visible below it.
Photo 1 shows a gearbox casing with electrical connectors and multi-colored wires (red, blue, orange) attached to sensors or solenoids.
Photo 2 shows the side of a gearbox with shift linkages, hoses, and electrical connectors; the casing is dirty and oily.
A watermark reading "NZ JAPANESE AUTOS" appears across all three photos.
No brand plate, model number, casting number, or VIN is readable on the gearbox in any photo.

proof_requests: Clear photo of any casting number, part number, or manufacturer plate on the gearbox casing
Video of the gearbox being shifted through all gears on a bench or in a vehicle
Close-up video of the input shaft, output shaft, and all seal areas for leaks or damage
Confirmation whether the unit is automatic or manual and which Toyota model/year it fits
